Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2 + `target:v18`:** it is the last reader of a v18-retired key after objectui#12654 (p2 + `target:v18`), and that card's grade carries over. No served row carries `visibleOn`, so nothing is wrong on screen today.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Re-read on `main` `5c0846ebd8`: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts:282` and `:292` still write `visibleOn`. ⛔ No consumer-side fold: the designer writes and reads `visibleWhen` only. Land after PR #12692.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (`priority:p2`, `target:v18`; triage grade `6218246740`)

Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the metadata-admin designer's own `visibleOn` dialect, in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`:
- `anchors.ts` (`:282`, `:292`): the two view-create properties re-spelled `visibleWhen`, and their pins in `view-create-body.test.ts`;
- `SchemaForm.tsx`: `readVisibility` reads `visibleWhen` only, and `CONDITION_FIELD_NAMES` drops `visibleOn` if no served schema names a property `visibleOn` (measure first);
- `form-spec.ts`: the `visibleOn` members of `FormSectionSpec` and `FormFieldSpec`, and the prose that names both;
- doc-comment prose only in `predicate.ts`, `view-schema.ts`, `page-schema.ts`, `report-schema.ts`, `mergeServerFields.ts`, `PageDefaultInspector.tsx` and `ViewVariantInspector.tsx`;
- tests beside them;
- one `.changeset/12696-*.md`.

Outside the surface:
- `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, until objectui#12745 (another seat, in flight on that file) has merged. If it has not merged when you push, leave its prose and list it as carried.
- `@object-ui/plugin-form` and the console form page (objectui#12654, landed).
- Any spec change.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Clause-② reason: `FormFieldSpec`, `FormSectionSpec` and `SchemaForm` are exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry (`index.ts:450`, `:507`–`:510`). Dropping their `visibleOn` members and the `?? visibleOn` read narrows a published type and the accept set of a published component, so the PR owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review.
Responsibility: n/a — the designer kept the old spelling after the spec retired it; objectui#12654 (PR #12692, landed) is named as the trigger that left it the last reader, not as its cause
Thread-read: 6218246740
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `c9e6742`. objectui#12654's PR #12692 merged as `611566b4df`. No open PR names `anchors.ts`, `SchemaForm.tsx`, `form-spec.ts`, `predicate.ts`, the three schema files, `mergeServerFields.ts`, `PageDefaultInspector.tsx` or `ViewVariantInspector.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read). PR #12745 touches `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, which is held outside the surface.
